## Routes (generated by `node interface/router.mjs --md`)

Every route works on one venture, named in front of it: its id, or its folder path for a nested venture (`studio/print`). Record routes read, write, check, view, lay out or show the template of one record type; a collection has a list route and an `[id]` item route; command routes run a venture-wide tool and can be viewed. A write is checked against the record's schema first; a record whose decision class escalates is written as a draft when an agent writes it, for a person to accept.

Asks first when the record is incomplete; input as_is runs it anyway |
| `purpose/validation/score` | command | run, view, layout | `schema/check-validation.mjs` |  |  | Held (EE-050): the single validation score from graded evidence (EE-026); purpose/validation/assess replaces it for the problem |
| `raw/dump` | record | read, view, layout | `raw/dump.md`, `purpose/ideas/dump.md` |  | (discovery) (validation) | The founder's raw idea dump: every idea about the venture, verbatim and unprompted. Never rewritten by an agent (EE-059) |
| `raw/sources` | record (list) | read, view, layout | `raw/sources/*/source.json` |  |  | Where a founder-supplied source came from. Raw is immutable (EE-070). |

| `system/cache` | command | run, view, layout | router |  |  | The venture's cache (C-1, C-17): entries by level, what is private to you, what has expired, and which routes are cached for how long; input value list, prune or clear |
| `system/context` | command | run, view, layout | `interface/context.mjs` |  |  | The context budget (N-13): what every route sends an agent, in tokens, against its budget, with the largest part and where to move it (S-14, F-6) |
| `system/freshness` | command | run, view, layout | `schema/freshness.mjs` |  |  | What is fresh, stale or expired, and which records are live holes: by time (freshness profiles, per phase too) and on demand (a dependency changed, a where-used parent drifted, a tag, path or package was revalidated) |
| `system/judge` | command | run, view, layout | router |  |  | Ask System 1 a typed request ({ state, model, questions }) through the judgment cache (S-8, C-5): reused answers are not asked again; the rest go to NAIVE_JUDGE_CMD in one request |
| `system/naive-config` | record | read, view, layout, write, check | `naive.config.json` | security-loosening |  | The venture's overrides to Naive's defaults (P-2, like next.config.js): the gate's static rules, function owners, check settings, thresholds, which System 1 questions run, pinned package versions and how strictly the acting role is checked. An agent's write of it is a draft, since it can loosen the gate |
| `system/need-now` | command | run, view, layout | `schema/need-now.mjs` |  |  | What the venture needs now, soon, or should hold back (EE-028) |
| `system/overview` | command | run, view, layout | router |  |  | The venture at a glance: telos, validation, need-now, time to ready, team and recent provenance, rendered as parallel slots |
| `system/package` | command | run, view, layout | `schema/packages.mjs` |  |  | The venture package (EE-067, EE-069): the core packages open now and the handoffs, each record confirmed, to review or to write, what moves on its own and what waits, and what completion unlocks; --write renders the view and records a version. Assumes a solo founder or small founding team in Discovery and Validation; agents are a package enhancement |

| `system/release` | record | read, view, layout | `.release/release.json`, `.release/card.json` |  | (beachhead) (scale) (platform) | A release (C-11, I-17): the venture's static shell, written by node schema/build-release.mjs. release.json is the manifest (confirmed records frozen in with their sha256, date and who confirmed them; named live holes; the route table as the release holds it; frozen command answers); card.json is the release card's data (P-25, O-7). The frozen copies under .release/records/ keep their own record types. Read without the router by node schema/start-release.mjs |

| `system/robots` | command | run, view, layout | router |  |  | Which roles may read and write which routes, from the team plan |
| `system/steps` | command | run, view, layout | `schema/model-steps.mjs` |  |  | The model steps' payload (use model, EE-073): what code computed, a placeholder for each judgment a model has yet to give, and the only fields each one receives; asks no model. mentura steps run asks one |
| `system/time-to-ready` | command | run, view, layout | `schema/time-to-ready.mjs` |  |  | Time to running, and to ready per layer and MAD tier |

Reads the events log that instrumentation writes |

| `validation/solution` | record | read, view, layout, write, check, template | `validation/solution.json`, `purpose/validation/solution.json` |  | (validation) (beachhead) | Validation sub-score: how it solves the problem and the evidence people choose it (EE-026) |
